I tum ber chu light zawng zawng OFF ( '.' in a entir) siam tur a ni.
Light hmetin i hmet chuan a inthlak danglam a, a thenawm te (chung/lam/chhak/tlang) pawh a inthlak danglam bawk.
[row col] type la, light hmet rawh (0 atanga index, chuvangin 0-{max_index} thleng a valid a ni).
{max_turns} move thleng i nei a, puzzle chhuang turin.
Legend: 'O' = light ON, '.' = light OFF
